title: Summoning team present the night of the egg

tellings.quote: I can tell you that that night there was another team present that I know of that uh deals with the summoning component of data collection.

plain: A former military helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he helped retrieve an egg-shaped craft in the California desert in 2014, says another team was there that night. According to Barber, that team handled what he calls the summoning part of data collection, meaning efforts to call such craft to appear. He says he was there himself; if true, it would mean someone was deliberately trying to bring these objects in as part of an organised effort.
